review_type: independent static code audit; no accelerator execution or runtime changes
status: all reported static-review findings resolved; parent-owned CPU mock tests, real tiny-checkpoint export and separately scheduled full-block H3 smoke remain validation gates
primary_question: With generator weights and the raw-observation warm start fixed, does an R_phi conditioning guide improve restoration, and does a predeclared fixed post-decode fidelity anchor add value?

fixed_recipe.port_scope: ComfyUI Open-H3 port; native Diffusers equivalence unverified
fixed_recipe.audio_initialization: zeros in both arms; audio output not scored
fixed_recipe.warm_start: one VAE encoding of prepared raw HR RGB, cloned unchanged for both H3 calls

arms.name: rphi_only
arms.purpose: same exported clipped float32 R_phi RGB reference

anchor_contract.source: same clipped R_phi prediction in both guide arms
anchor_contract.native_tasks: x + alpha * (r - x), full RGB fidelity blend
anchor_contract.sr: x + alpha * Q4_right_inverse(Q4(r) - Q4(x)), canonical bicubic antialias Q4
anchor_contract.stage: after final H3 decode, without VAE re-encoding
anchor_contract.clipping: apply correction to raw decoded H3 RGB, then clip; unanchored H3 metrics also clip; no RGB8 quantization
anchor_contract.clipping_residuals: soft-anchor report includes preclip, postclip and dtype-rounding canonical/fidelity residuals
anchor_contract.alpha_policy: one declared alpha=0.25; no dev-set grid search or per-sample choice
anchor_contract.endpoint_warning: alpha=1 native collapses to R_phi-only; it cannot establish H3 benefit. SR alpha=1 retains the H3 canonical-null component before clipping.

geometry_and_temporal_contract.guide_preparation: rphi_data.prepare_observed; exact x4 bicubic antialias upsample only for SR, native tasks remain at their observation geometry
geometry_and_temporal_contract.spatial_admission: HR dimensions divisible by 32, because H3 patchification requires an even latent spatial grid
geometry_and_temporal_contract.rphi_context: all 22 predictions, consecutive t-2,t-1,t histories with first-frame repetition
geometry_and_temporal_contract.h3_context: full 22-frame block supplied to VAE and H3; no verified end-to-end frame-causal contract
geometry_and_temporal_contract.temporal_metric: same adjacent-frame RGB error-change and masked GT-proxy-flow support for every arm

data_and_metric_contract.input_files: materialization receipt + NPZ file + pixel hashes; export NPZ array hashes and provenance sidecar hashes
data_and_metric_contract.target_usage: geometry/integrity validation and metrics only; no target values enter raw preparation, exported guide, VAE, warm start, conditioning or anchor
data_and_metric_contract.guide_semantics: exported rgb float32 THWC clipped [0,1]; raw_rgb retained for separate diagnostics; no uint8 or video intermediate
data_and_metric_contract.metrics: eval_rphi.rgb_metrics and temporal_metrics on float32 clipped predictions and original uint8 recording proxy /255
data_and_metric_contract.lpips: same locally loaded network/weights and CPU execution across all arms
data_and_metric_contract.aggregation: matched per-source differences, equal source weights, separately by task
data_and_metric_contract.scope: 8 development sources, not an untouched generalization test
data_and_metric_contract.failure_policy: fresh output directory, partial/failure evidence allowed, complete=true only after all selected samples succeed

three_step_innerdc_boundary.meaning: Legacy innerDC reduces to a final-step denoised-latent correction; it is not three separate corrections on a three-step schedule
three_step_innerdc_boundary.vae_limitation: Projection residual is measured before VAE encoding; the final decoded RGB is not guaranteed to retain it
three_step_innerdc_boundary.native_identity_warning: If a native physical identity operator is used with hard projection, the projection replaces all RGB with its supplied target; this is not a null-only refinement
three_step_innerdc_boundary.decision: Keep this first factorial in base mode with post-decode soft anchoring; any later innerDC study needs a VAE-roundtrip-only control and final decoded residual measurements

minimum_acceptance_before_full_run: CPU fixture export: source/input/guide/file/provenance mutations, early checkpoint, invalid histories and unsupported geometry must fail before H3 construction
Fake H3: exactly two sample calls, equal raw warm-start bytes and seeds, differing only conditioning, no target pixels, no guide/draft mutation
Soft-anchor controls: alpha=0 identity, chosen alpha=0.25 finite outputs, native interpolation and SR canonical residual including clipping tested
Six-arm metric fixture: identical generated arrays score identically; common frame list and source weighting; R_phi-only reference preserved
Real scheduled smoke: complete one source with all four tasks, 22-frame encode/decode and three denoiser evaluations per call; verify actual schedule/seed/mode/audio/warm-start records
Only after smoke, evaluate all 8 sources/32 task samples; require 64 H3 calls and 192 denoiser evaluations, with soft anchors using no extra generator calls
